method: ffmpeg. Frame grabs at 0.5 s over the first and last 8 s (320 px) plus a 0.5 s/40 s strip of the lower-third band, all read by eye. Numbers from per-frame signalstats YAVG (10-bit limited black = 64) for black/fade/card structure, from a near-white pixel share inside the lower-third band (crop 0.55w x 0.14h at 0.03w,0.76h -> gray -> threshold 200) for super in/out, and from astats RMS at 0.1 s (0.02 s at the Taurus entrance) for the music. Super spans are full-strength; the fades either side run ~0.3 s.
